title: Schedule
heroLead: Follow the main seminar events from the first information session through examinations and results.
introduction: The seminar application process runs for roughly half a year. Collect information at each stage, check the latest announcements, and prepare early. Exact dates will be published once they are confirmed.
notice: The periods below are a general guide based on the previous schedule. Always use the current Examination and News pages for confirmed dates and requirements.

steps.title: First Seminar Information Session
steps.description: Get an overview of Zemi, the annual schedule, and the application process. Individual information sessions may also be announced.

steps.title: Second Seminar Information Session
steps.description: Learn more about individual seminars and how selection may use examinations, interviews, grades, or written work.

steps.title: Mita Festival Thesis Presentation
steps.description: Explore research papers and presentations from each Zemi, and compare the fields and seminar cultures that interest you.

steps.title: Professor Information Sessions
steps.description: Hear directly from professors about their research themes, seminar policies, and application requirements.

steps.title: Open Seminar
steps.description: Experience real seminar activities at Mita Campus and get a closer feel for the atmosphere of each Zemi.

steps.title: Third Seminar Information Session
steps.description: Review confirmed deadlines, application formats, and the latest examination details before applying.

steps.title: Registration Day
steps.description: Register for your chosen seminar within the stated period and monitor the website and official social channels for updates.

steps.title: Examination Date A / Results
steps.description: Take the Date A examination. Students continuing the process should also check the registration information for Date B.

steps.title: Date B Results / Date C
steps.description: Check Date B results and, where applicable, the registration and result procedures for Date C.
